note: Mechanical merge of copy_catalog_enUS_nlNL_v0.1.json and copy_patch_enUS_nlNL_v0.2.json, both authored by ChatGPT. No copy was written or altered here; the patch simply overrides the one key it replaces. This file exists because the build gate has to check copy_keys against a single in-repo source. v0.4 adds the item-level comparison copy. The BELOW_* set and NOT_NOW_1 are ChatGPT's exact wording with the numbers lifted into parameters; the AT_* and FAR_* sets were written by Claude Code in the same factual register and still need ChatGPT's review.
